hint.threadsEmpty: Type a word to search chat titles and messages.

none.title: No results for “{{query}}”
none.inThreads_one: Not in articles, but there is 1 chat.
none.inThreads_other: Not in articles, but there are {{count}} chats.
none.advice: Try a shorter word or remove the quotes; articles hidden by rules don’t appear here.
none.threadsAdvice: Only unarchived chats are searched; archived chats are in “Archived” in the sidebar.

foot.local: Local full-text search · no model calls

tips.articlesBody: Titles and body text are both searched. For Chinese, any two or more characters work; English is case-insensitive. Wrap a phrase in quotes like "local-first" to match it exactly. Articles hidden by rules don’t appear here.
tips.threadsBody: Chat titles and your messages with the assistant are both searched; archived chats and digest follow-ups aren’t included. Opening a result jumps to the matched message.

thread.goMessage: Press Enter to open the chat at this message
thread.goLatest: Press Enter to open the chat from the latest message

filter.threadsNote: Unarchived chats only, including titles and messages

preview.label: Preview
preview.blocksError: Matched paragraphs aren’t available right now; open the article to find them in the body.
preview.goBody: Click or press Enter to open at the first matched paragraph in the body.
preview.goTitle: Title match only: click or press Enter to open from the top.
